# opnsense_dnsmasq_boot (Resource)

Dnsmasq network boot entries (Services > Dnsmasq DNS & DHCP > DHCP boot): the PXE/TFTP boot file and server handed to DHCP clients.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_dnsmasq_tag" "pxe" {
  tag = "pxe"
}

# Hand clients tagged "pxe" the iPXE loader from the TFTP server.
resource "opnsense_dnsmasq_boot" "ipxe" {
  filename       = "ipxe.efi"
  server_address = "192.168.10.5"
  tags           = [opnsense_dnsmasq_tag.pxe.id]
  description    = "iPXE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filename` (String) Boot file, e.g. `pxelinux.0` or `ipxe.efi`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to `""`.
- `interface` (String) Only answer on this interface; empty answers on all. Defaults to `""`.
- `server_address` (String) Boot (TFTP) server address; empty uses this firewall. Defaults to `""`.
- `server_name` (String) Boot server host name. Defaults to `""`.
- `tags` (Set of String) UUIDs of `opnsense_dnsmasq_tag`s a client must have for this entry to apply; empty applies to all. Defaults to `[]`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the entry.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import opnsense_dnsmasq_boot.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
